full_name: James P. O'Dwyer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Medicine Hrdy Fellow University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
bio: James P. O’Dwyer is an ecologist in the Department of Plant Biology at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. His research focuses on the emergent properties of complex systems, especially the stability and biodiversity of ecological communities and the ways in which humans interact with and affect these properties.
